```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r render, echo=FALSE}
library(metaboprep2)

# the data
data_file <- system.file("extdata", "metabolon_v1_example.xlsx", package = "metaboprep2")

# create the object
metabolites <- Metabolites(project_name = "MYPROJECT",
                           format       = "metabolon_v1",
                           filepath     = data_file)

# import the data
metabolites <- import_data(metabolites)

# run QC
metabolites <- metabolite_qc(metabolites, source="raw")

# render report
generate_report(metabolites,
                output_dir=getwd(),
                output_filename=NULL,
                format="html",
                template="qc_report")
```

